svg.aria-label: Beyond the Code. Outside of work, I ask the same “how does this work?” question about everyday things: why streets are shaped the way they are, what a neighbourhood used to be, and why a story landed or didn’t. I’ll happily overanalyze why a transit line runs where it does, or what the Keyblade really means in Kingdom Hearts, and I’ll explain it to you in any way that I can.
